import.title: CSV / XLSX import
import.dropHint: Drop a .csv, .txt or .xlsx file here, or pick it. One row is one document; the columns follow the sample.
import.limits: One file, at most 50 MB and 500 rows. Issued and received documents can be mixed (the direction column).

upload.tooLarge: The file is too large (50 MB at most).

fileError.invalid: The file cannot be read. Upload a CSV (UTF-8 or Windows-1250) or an XLSX workbook.
fileError.empty: The file contains no data rows.
fileError.invalid_column: Invalid column {column} (a vat_ column needs its base_ column, and the rate must be a number).
fileError.too_many: Too many rows (500 at most). Split the file into smaller parts.
fileError.too_large: The XLSX workbook is too large once unpacked (200 MB at most). Split the file into smaller parts.

rowError.invalid_amount: Invalid amount (unreadable, too large, wrong sign or too many decimal places).
rowError.no_vat_rows: No VAT rate column is filled in.
rowError.total_mismatch: The total does not match the VAT recap (bases + VAT + rounding).
rowError.not_allowed: This combination is not allowed for the document type (e.g. a tax point date on a proforma, VAT outside the standard mode, a payment date on an advance tax document).
rowError.number_taken: The number from the received series is already taken. Check the counter in Settings.
rowError.storage_unavailable: The file storage is unavailable. Try the import later.

notAllowed.taxDate: A proforma has no tax point date.
notAllowed.paidDate: An advance tax document cannot have a payment date.
notAllowed.vat: VAT is allowed only in the standard VAT mode.

warning.contact_created: A contact will be created from the row.
warning.category_inactive: The category is inactive; the document will be imported without a category.
warning.related_not_found: Original document {number} was not found; it will not be linked.
